## Summary
- Point README clipboard/file-transfer status to the 2026-09-08 Nubia P0110 no-Host UI/UX current-main evidence package.
- Update Phase 1 actionable UI evidence wording to reference the retained current-main device instrumentation record.
- Keep the no-Host boundary explicit: this does not prove Host-backed bytes landing, Android/macOS ClipboardManager <-> NSPasteboard E2E, Phase 1 closure, or Phase 0 stable release.

## Verification
- git diff --check
- README docs-link existence check: missing_links=0
- shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-22-android-ui-ux-audit/evidence/2026-09-08-nubia-p0110-no-host-uiux-current-main/SHA256SUMS
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=92a6df59216cddfe2f1eb53a87f6245d18533a15
- Independent read-only audit confirmed the README wording matches the evidence package and keeps Clipboard/File Transfer E2E plus Phase 1/Phase 0 gates open.

## Boundary
The referenced evidence is Android no-Host UI/UX instrumentation on Nubia P0110/pacific only. It must not be reported as Xiaomi 13/fuxi evidence and it does not launch or validate the macOS Host, TCC state, real transport, LAN/Internet traversal, or Host-backed clipboard/file bytes landing.
